lines: Fire Art Squad
Take this! Fire Jutsu!
UFS Soldier
Don't shrink back! Surround and subdue them!
Intense gunfire boomed and flames from the Ninja Arts flashed.
The narrow backstreets had turned into a battlefield between the UFS troops and the Taimanin squad.
Me
This is bad. At this rate, we'll never make progress...
I (the boar) muttered as I charged into UFS soldiers, sending them flying.
The Fire Art squad also fought desperately, but, blocked by the UFS's stout line of defense, we were unable to proceed onward.
Asagi
Yeah. The time we have left is rapidly dwindling while we're stuck here.
Asagi-san said worriedly.
The deadline to kill Kiyomaro, the lucky boar, was the end of the day.
We didn't have time to let them keep stalling us in a place like this.
Asuka
Hmhm. I told you to stop resisting and give up already. You're outnumbered by a ton♪
Compared to us, Asuka was beyond calm and composed, leading the UFS forces.
If it were simply a matter of being outnumbered, we should've easily been able to break through the UFS squad with Asagi-san's and Homura's power.
But the Asuka from this dimension also seemed to be an exceptional fighter.
She stood in front of Asagi-san and Homura, who attacked the soldiers in an attempt to break through the blockade,
and staved off their fierce attacks with her Android Arms.
Asuka's presence drove us into a deadlock...
Me
Hngh, surrender!? Not a chance!!
Me
My ability to return to my original form depends on this!
Asuka
Your original form?
Me

Yes! I'm actually a humanー
but I was made into a "scapegoat" by the lucky boar! Get the hint and let us through!
Asuka
Hmmm, so you're really a human, huh?
Asuka
Well, if we dissect you we'll get to the bottom of it. Hurry up and capture that boar! We're gonna bring it to the lab.
Me
You monster!!
She appeared to have no intention of believing me.
Me
(Dammit! Since it's come to thisー)
Me
Come over here, Sanada Homura!! I've got an idea!
Homura
Oh, fake boar? What is it?
Hearing my voice, Homura, who had been fighting nearby, came over.
Homura
Not that it matters much, but you really do look delicious up close. Can I roast you and take a quick bite?
Me

Why would I agree to that!? A-Anywayー
I've got a favor to ask!!
This was my last resort.
I didn't really like being so forceful, but this time it was unavoidable.
Me
If this keeps up, it's just going to get worse and worse for us.
Me
Either we run out of time without managing to move forward, or they overpower us with their numbers. Neither is a good outcome.
Homura
Right? The prospects are a little crummy.
Homura nodded in agreement with my assessment of the situation.
Me
So there you have it. Asagi-san and I will forcefully break through their blockade.
Me
If the Fire Art Squad provides backup, at least the two of us should be able to squeeze through.
Homura
Hmm. We should be able to do that, but... isn't that stupidly strong woman the real problem?
Homura pointed at Asuka.
Me

You're right. The problem is Asuka. That's whyー
I'd like you to take care of the steel lady.
Homura
Huh!? Me!? You're telling me to take on that ridiculously strong, pain-in-the-ass woman alone!?
Me
Yeah... I know I'm asking a lot. But you're the only one strong enough toー
Homura
Good! Sounds awesome!! I'll absolutely do it!!
Me
Huh? You're fine with it...?
Contrary to my expectations, Homura seemed to like my plan a lot.
Homura
Is this where I say, "You go ahead! Leave this to me!!" like you always read in manga!?
Homura
I've always wanted to say that~♪
Me
I-Is that so...?
I wasn't really sure why, but she gladly agreed to my plan.
Asuka
...What are you whispering about? If you don't come here, I'll come after you myself!!
Asuka must have sensed something from us and challenged us on her own.
Me
There's no time to keep talking. At any rate, go with the plan!
Asagi

Rogerー
Sorry to ask this of you, Sanada-san.
Homura
Yeah!! Just leave this to me!!
